context: Souvera Central Nextcloud v34 Management App - User Editor Screen

typography.general: Rely on Nextcloud system fonts via CSS variables. Enforce strict hierarchy and tightness.

headings.card_title: text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-[color:var(--color-main-text)] uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.2em]

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid - grid-cols-1 xl:grid-cols-12 gap-8

regions.header: col-span-full flex justify-between items-end mb-4 border-b border-[color:var(--color-border)] pb-4

surface_strategy.cards: Flat background bg-[color:var(--color-background-dark)], 1px border border-[color:var(--color-border)], rounded-[var(--border-radius-large)] p-6 shadow-sm

header.structure: Title + 'Zurück zur Übersicht' standard Nextcloud back button.
header.style: Align items cleanly, use tight leading.

user_type_selector.design: Two side-by-side or stacked selectable cards (Souvera User vs Nextcloud User).
user_type_selector.active_state: 2px solid var(--color-primary), bg-[color:var(--color-primary)] with 10% opacity, primary colored icon.

base_info_card.title: Basisdaten
base_info_card.fields: Anzeigename, Email (input + domain dropdown), Passwort, Manager, Status. Inputs must have identical height (e.g., 40px).

email_aliases_panel.title: E-Mail & Aliase
email_aliases_panel.structure: A sleek, structured list instead of a dark monolithic block.
email_aliases_panel.usage_bar: Thin horizontal progress bar at the very top of the card.
email_aliases_panel.quota_row: Placed at the top or bottom of the list in a distinct sub-panel (bg-[color:var(--color-main-background)]).
email_aliases_panel.primary_row: Bold text, un-deletable, distinct 'Primär' badge (bg-[color:var(--color-primary)] text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded).
email_aliases_panel.alias_rows: Flex row, border-b border-[color:var(--color-border)], py-3. Email left, Trash icon button right. Hover effect on row: bg-[color:var(--color-background-hover)].
email_aliases_panel.add_alias_form: Nested panel with distinct background. Flex row: Input(localpart) + '@' + Select(domain) + Button(Hinzufügen). Uniform 40px height for all three controls. Eliminates jagged edges.

groups_card.title: Gruppenzugehörigkeit
groups_card.panes: Split neatly into 'Mitglied' and 'Administration' with crisp labels.

actions_bento.title: Erweiterte Aktionen
actions_bento.destructive_actions: Standard border, but on hover: border-[color:var(--color-error)] text-[color:var(--color-error)] to prevent visual overload of red buttons.

states_and_interactions.inputs: Focus ring must be visible: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[color:var(--color-primary)].
states_and_interactions.buttons: Hover: Slight brightness adjustment or opacity change.
states_and_interactions.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for hovers and focus states.

testing.data_testids: MUST persist all original data-testids. Add new semantic ones where missing (e.g., data-testid='user-editor-save', data-testid='alias-add-btn', data-testid='alias-delete-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Convert the current flat 4-column layout into a 'Control Room' Bento Grid (xl:grid-cols-12).
Place the Base Information and Email Aliases in the wide main column (col-span-8), and the User Type cards and Actions in the side column (col-span-4).
Redesign the 'Email-Aliase' section to be a clean list format with a dedicated, visually grouped row for adding new aliases. Ensure input, select, and button heights perfectly match.
Style the 'Benutzer-Typ' toggle as two elegant, clickable cards rather than standard radios.
Use strictly Nextcloud CSS variables (var(--color-*)) for all styling to guarantee identical Light/Dark mode compatibility.

Investigate the API call for 'Aliase anlegen'. The user noted an error, likely due to an outdated Stalwart CLI format. Ensure the payload and request structure in the add alias method matches the latest Stalwart implementation.
